prior: LOW-MEDIUM. Bounce entries failed before (Connors RSI-2 green 10/14, RSI-2 turn 10/13, RSI <30 over 60 days, limit-below dips kept falling 10/14). This one needs both %R lines exhausted together and then turning, which none of those required.
rule: early_entry_honest.os_leave_flag on the gridded IEX minute series (same %R lines as PRE): os_tri(i-k) for some k in 1..3 (both <= -80, |fast-slow| <= 15), minute i not in the triangle and not 'both <= -80 but wide', fast rising (> previous + 0.05). Onsets with the harness refractory (15 min), 09:50-15:30 window, board minutes only.
fill_markout_control_cost_statistic_spli: Identical to early_entry_mid_rsi2_prereg.json: entry at the SIP open of the next minute, exit at the SIP close 9 minutes after the entry bar (10-minute hold); control = random LATER minute of the same name (entry+1..+60, seed sha256(symbol|day|entry_minute|OSL|early-honest-v1)); 10 bp round trip on both; lift = rule net - control net, day-equal mean, day-clustered t; half A ends 2026-09-24.
pass: Each half PASS = day-equal lift >= +5 bp with day-clustered t >= 2.0, day-equal net > 0, >= 100 scored signals, >= 6 days. OSL is PASS only if both halves PASS; FAIL if either FAILs; else UNDERPOWERED (not evidence either way).
information_only: cross control (another board name, same minute), close entry, 20 bp cost
no_retuning: -80 / 15 / 3 bars, the window, refractory, hold, cost and split are fixed. Other levels, leave windows or holds are a new prereg.
if_pass: Provisional: forward test on >= 10 sessions after 2026-10-15 with the same bar (the live ▲ arm in shadow), then a result-skeptic review of the positive, before any arm change.
if_fail: The completed-bar leave-oversold entry is closed on the free feed; the ▲ arm stays off.
script: tools/studies/early_entry_honest.py --study os_leave (--score only after a result-skeptic READY); tests/test_early_entry_honest.py::test_os_leave_needs_triangle_then_leave_rising
